exec_summary: Site traffic (GA4, 2026-06-20 to 2026-06-26): growthbook.io had 13,518 sessions and 9,028 users (-17.3% week over week).

**Site performance**
- **Overall (GA4, all traffic):** 13,518 sessions (-17.3% WoW) | 9,028 users
- **Overall (GSC, organic search):** 3,393 clicks (-2.0% WoW) | 286,052 impressions (+46.6% WoW)
- **Homepage (/):** 8,535 GA4 sessions (-1.6% WoW) all-traffic | 1,887 GSC clicks (-2.5% WoW) organic | 14,419 GSC impressions (+0.1% WoW)
- **Pricing (/pricing):** 1,189 GA4 sessions (+2.6% WoW) all-traffic | 88 GSC clicks (-9.3% WoW) organic | 7,366 GSC impressions (+21.3% WoW)
- **Docs (docs.growthbook.io):** 4,399 GA4 sessions (-1.7% WoW) all-traffic | 1,045 GSC clicks (-5.0% WoW) organic | 256,627 GSC impressions (+97.9% WoW)
- **All other pages:** 6,219 GA4 sessions (-38.7% WoW) all-traffic | 369 GSC clicks (+11.1% WoW) organic | 191,154 GSC impressions (+43.7% WoW)
- All-other-pages GA4 all-traffic dropped -38.7% while GSC organic clicks rose +11.1% — the AI-search-displacement pattern (traffic arriving via AI assistants that GSC doesn't capture) has now reversed: organic is holding but GA4 is down, suggesting the prior week's GA4 spike was a one-week anomaly. Docs impressions nearly doubled WoW (+97.9%) — worth monitoring for a ranking event or a sitemap re-crawl artifact.

**New competitor activity**
- **Optimizely** launched a coordinated content blitz: 29 new Tier 1 pages detected this week across its new "Field Notes" hub — including vertical use-case playbooks (financial services, retail, B2B SaaS), an "Agentic AI Experimentation Benchmark" guide, a "Build vs. Buy" debate piece, and a refreshed "Experimentation" product update page. This is the largest single-week content drop from any competitor in this dataset. The vertical use-case pages (financial services, retail, B2B) directly compete with GrowthBook's mid-funnel content gap and are positioned to capture BOFU queries GrowthBook doesn't currently cover.
- **Optimizely** "AI Experimentation" article (KD 52) is the highest-competition new piece in the batch — now in its fifth consecutive week of AI experimentation content. GrowthBook's **/blog/a-b-testing-in-the-age-of-ai** remains unrefreshed and unactioned from prior recommendations.
- No new pages detected from **Statsig**, **Harness**, **LaunchDarkly**, **Flagsmith**, or **Unleash** this week — given last week's heavy output from Harness and Flagsmith, this is likely a monitoring gap rather than a simultaneous content pause across five competitors.

**New GrowthBook content**
- **/blog/flagsmith-alternatives-feature-flagging** and **/blog/unleash-alternatives** — noticed this week via sitemap (real publish dates unknown). Both are zero-impression alternatives pages that directly intercept mid-funnel comparison queries. Add internal links immediately from established posts.
- **/insights/react-feature-flags-growthbook** — noticed this week via sitemap, zero impressions. Developer-ICP page; needs internal links from the feature flagging cluster.
- **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared** (published 2026-05-18): 120 clicks this week, up from 42 last week and 94 two weeks ago — strong recovery, now the top-performing new content asset. Position improved to 8.1.
- **/blog/a-practitioners-guide-to-treatment-effects**: 23 clicks (up from 9 last week, +6 delta this week) — momentum is real; add internal links now to sustain it.
- **/blog/kpi-playbook-ab-testing-metrics** (published 2026-06-03): 13 clicks, 2,172 impressions, position 7.5 — new entry, healthy early traction.

**Strategic priorities (ACP)**
- **Top-10 footprint: 165 keywords (+67 over 3 months)** — trajectory unchanged, momentum holding.
- **BOFU comparison page fix remains the highest-ROI work in the account. Eight pages have cleared the persistence gate.** This recommendation has appeared four or more consecutive weeks without shipping. Priority order:
  - **/compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly** (ACP 82, pos 9.7, 2,925 impressions/28d, AI Overview present, GrowthBook cited)
  - **/compare/growthbook-vs-statsig** (ACP 82, pos 7.4, 2,207 impressions/28d, AI Overview present, GrowthBook cited)
  - **/compare/growthbook-vs-posthog** (ACP 80, pos 6.4, 4,427 impressions/28d, AI Overview present, GrowthBook cited) — highest impression volume
  - **/compare/growthbook-vs-optimizely** (ACP 80, pos 9.8, 2,051 impressions/28d, AI Overview present, GrowthBook NOT cited) — 2 clicks/7d despite strong impressions
- **"what is a/b testing"** (pos 11.72, 925 impressions, AI Overview present, GrowthBook NOT cited) — unactioned for four consecutive weeks. **/blog/what-is-a-b-testing** dropped from 24 to 13 clicks this week; adding an answer-capsule H2 is the single fastest fix.

**Organic movers worth watching**
- **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared**: 120 clicks (up from 42, +186%) — recovery confirmed. No action needed; monitor position drift.
- **/blog/what-is-a-b-testing**: 13 clicks (down from 24, -46%) — second consecutive week of decline. GA4 check warranted before assuming a title/CTR fix; if GA4 all-traffic is also down, the answer-capsule H2 is the priority action.
- **/insights/best-ab-testing-tools-developers**: 6 clicks (up from 1) — new mover in the developer tools cluster. Watch one more week.
- **/blog/a-practitioners-guide-to-treatment-effects**: 9 clicks (up from 3) — third consecutive week of growth. Internal links now.
- **/insights/matched-pairs-design-explained**: 9 clicks (down from 15) — reversed after two weeks of growth. No action yet but worth watching.

**Recommended actions**
- **Ship the answer-capsule + comparison table + schema fix to /compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly, /compare/growthbook-vs-statsig, and /compare/growthbook-vs-posthog this week** (ACP 82, 82, 80). All three have AI Overviews where GrowthBook IS cited. This is the fifth consecutive week this recommendation has appeared.
- **Apply the same fix to /compare/growthbook-vs-optimizely this week** (ACP 80, 2,051 impressions/28d, 2 clicks/7d, AI Overview present, GrowthBook NOT cited). Optimizely's 29-page content blitz this week makes this more urgent, not less.
- **Add an answer-capsule H2 to /blog/what-is-a-b-testing targeting "what is a/b testing"** (pos 11.72, 925 impressions, 1,900 monthly searches, AI Overview present, GrowthBook NOT cited). Page is now declining two weeks in a row.
- **Add internal links from established posts to /blog/flagsmith-alternatives-feature-flagging, /blog/unleash-alternatives, and /insights/react-feature-flags-growthbook** — all three are new zero-impression pages that need link equity to index.
